notes: `לְשַׁכֵּן` divides as the written *to* on the preposition (rule 52) and the whole causative *cause ... to dwell* on the Piel infinitive, headed on the complement verb under rule 44.
`צֹאן` and `בָקָר` are bare nominals of material: the supplied *of* is licensed by their own case-function (rule 33) and the supplied *the*s join the nouns (rule 15).
